shots.detail_en: Hook close-up: morning corner of the brokerage, three desks 'on duty' — Chang Hong's hand-lettered 'LU SIR' card / Hongli's self-printed 'Acting Analyst' sign / Man Cang tying a red flower onto the mop
shots.sub: 满："咱这叫——'一路长虹私募'！" 红（画外）："叫'学习小组'。"
shots.speaker: MANCANG/RED

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Hongli draws two lines on a small whiteboard: 'WAR FUNDS' and 'SURVIVAL FUNDS' (EP14's two-pot system lands)
shots.sub: 红："保命金这条线，谁碰谁出局。满仓——第三条规矩，你背。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Man Cang recites the rules on his fingers
shots.sub: 满："亏光不哭！不借钱加仓！我爹养老钱不——"（卡壳）"……满仓的爹，不进市场！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Chang Hong watches Man Cang's father delivering soup in the distance and deepens rule three
shots.sub: 长："满仓，你爹那碗汤，比行情贵。行情亏了，还能赚回来——爹的十年，买不回来。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Assembly-line montage: Chang Hong hand-drawing charts / Hongli verifying trade receipts / Man Cang running orders (one draws, one checks, one runs)
shots.sub: 旁白："她做我的眼睛，他做我的腿。我——做K线的翻译官。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Wide: retail traders voluntarily clear an observation spot before the giant board for Chang Hong (status seed pays off)
shots.sub: 散户甲："让让，让陆先生看屏！"
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Hongli freezes over the receipt slips — the order paths of three accounts look like 'one person'
shots.sub: 红："长虹，咱们的单子……越来越像了。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Chang Hong's pen tip stalls, ink blot spreading
shots.sub: 长："像，就好。像——就危险了。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Top-floor machine room: Xiong Wei's giant screen streams an abstract account-behavior matrix (fictional abstract visuals)
shots.sub: 熊伟："重复的路径，不是运气。是——信号。"
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Explosive close-up: three red boxes lock onto the screen one by one — Chang Hong's account / Hongli's linked orders / Man Cang's account — three red lines merge into one path labeled 'Group-01'
shots.sub: 熊伟："恭喜。你们仨，是我模型里的第一个'集群样本'。"
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Xiong Wei pushes his rimless glasses, screen glare covering his eyes
shots.sub: 熊伟："样本会长大。长大，才值得……收割。"
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Xiong Tiancheng strolls into the machine room, glances at his son's screen, prayer beads turning once
shots.sub: 熊："别动他们。" 熊伟："为什么？" 熊："我的规矩——猎物要看够了行情，才舍得下注。"
shots.speaker: XIONG/XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Xiong Wei types one tag without a flicker: 'OBSERVATION — 30 TRADING DAYS'
shots.sub: 熊伟："观察期。三十个交易日。"
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: after close, Hongli shuts the trio's little ledger and stamps it (small founding ritual echoing Man Cang's rooftop one)
shots.sub: 红："账平了。今天，我们仨——一个都没亏。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Chang Hong lays his father's old notebook open beside the new ledger (two books side by side — two generations)
shots.sub: 长："爸，咱们小组……收了两个新人。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Two-shot at the window: Chang Hong and Hongli shoulder to shoulder watching the distant board (alliance deepening, paving EP16)
shots.sub: 红："下一个行情，什么时候来？" 长："等潮起。潮起的时候，连熊都拦不住。"
shots.speaker: RED/CH

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Man Cang holds up an instant camera for a group shot; at the shutter click Chang Hong isn't looking at the lens — his eyes are on the board's candlesticks in the photo corner
shots.sub: 满（画外）："茄子——全仓！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Insert: the photo developing — three figures slowly surfacing on the emulsion (period-piece visual, warmth)
shots.sub: 无

shots.detail_en: Night machine room: Xiong Wei prints the 'Group-01' path chart and pins it to the wall — beside it already hangs a 1993-era path chart from the old data (mirror composition)
shots.sub: 熊伟："爸的旧数据里，这条路径，有个名字。"
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Suspense macro: handwritten index code at the old path chart's corner — 'L-1993'
shots.sub: 熊伟（画外）："陆。"
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Black screen with next-episode card
shots.sub: 字幕："熊伟标记的第一条路径，起点在十年前——而下一个行情，叫做'回归'。"
shots.card: 熊伟标记的第一条路径，起点在十年前——而下一个行情，叫做'回归'。
